faq.question: Can your staff handle communication with insurance adjusters?
faq.answer: Yes. Our legal assistants and case managers are trained to correspond with adjusters — sending demand letters, following up on pending approvals, and escalating when needed. They document everything in your CRM.

faq.question: Are your staff bilingual in workers' comp terminology?
faq.answer: All of our staff are fluent in English and Spanish. For workers' comp specifically, we train on key terminology — IMEs, lien letters, compromise & release vs. stipulation, and state-specific processes — before placing anyone on your cases.

faq.question: What software do your staff use?
faq.answer: Our team works within your existing systems — Filevine, Clio, MyCase, Litify, or any other CMS. We also use Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and common communication tools. No new software required on your end.

faq.question: Is there a contract or minimum commitment?
faq.answer: No long-term contracts. We work month-to-month and you can scale up or down based on your caseload. Most firms expand to additional staff within 60 days once they see the impact.
